issues.where: whole plant: leaf count, size and arrangement
issues.what: b is a different plant: about 5 large leaves widely spaced on a long bare stem, versus a's dense stack of 8-10 leaves crowding up the stem to a tight bud; the head sits higher (top near y≈180 vs y≈210) and the top leaves spread wider, flat to camera
issues.fix: rebuild the plant to a's structure: more, smaller leaves set close together up the stem, a compact bud crowned by small upright leaves, and the head lowered to a's height

issues.what: a has a soft, out-of-focus tree line on low rolling hills with fog lying low in the field; b has a hard-edged, jagged mountain silhouette sitting on a flat, even grey-white fog band that looks pasted in, with no depth of field and no air between layers
issues.fix: replace the mountains with a's low, dark, soft-focus tree-covered hills and let fog thin out in patches across the far field, matched to a's dark, low-key value

issues.what: in a the background plants are dark, defocused and fall off into fog; in b they are sharp, evenly lit, grey-silver flat shapes, as bright as the foreground and cut out against the fog, with no depth of field
issues.fix: darken the far plants heavily, defocus them with distance, and let fog swallow them as in a

issues.where: leaf lighting on the main plant (regions 1-3)
issues.what: a's leaves are near-silhouettes lit only by a thin cool rim along edges and hairs; b's leaves glow bright green as if lit from behind, with visible veins, and the lower leaf on the right and the leaf in the lower middle get a flat grey-white sheen like a plastic mold
issues.fix: remove the green backlight glow and the grey sheen; keep leaf faces dark blue-green with only a cool rim on edges

issues.where: upper sky around the top of the Milky Way
issues.what: b has vertical streaks/smears and blocky soft patches in the Milky Way's upper end, with the cloud fading into a vertical smear; a shows a continuous textured dust band with fine stars
issues.fix: remove the vertical streaks and continue the Milky Way upward with a's fine mottled texture and dark dust lanes

issues.what: b's band is shifted slightly and is softer and less contrasty; the bright core near x≈350,y≈380 has less dust-lane detail than a
issues.fix: match a's band path and restore contrast and dust-lane detail in the core

issues.what: b's stem is thicker, darker and straight with sparse coarse hairs; a's stem is thinner with dense fine silvery rim-lit hairs
issues.fix: thin the stem and add a's dense, fine, rim-lit hair halo

issues.where: left edge of the sky and the glow at the horizon
issues.what: a has a strong bluish airglow at the lower left rising off the horizon; in b it is weaker and the stars at the lower left look larger and brighter
issues.fix: bring back a's lower-left horizon glow and match star size and density

issues.what: b's blacks in the foreground are lifted to grey and its overall contrast is flatter than a's deep near-black foreground
issues.fix: crush the foreground blacks to a's depth
